Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Revenue Protcetion Order No. 2/2019 (Revenue Protcetion Act No. 19 of 1962
(Import Duty on Super Diesel & other w.e.f. 12.06.2019)
reasoning: This gazette contains a Customs Notification and Revenue Protection Order issued under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962. It establishes new regulatory requirements for import duties on specific goods (Super Diesel and other products), which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or make personnel changes - the focus is entirely on regulatory implementation of customs duties.
